principle: Self-reference and self-narration establish an agent identity claim, never authority by assertion.
recursiveIdentity: Agents may model and narrate themselves and other agents; recursion does not bypass grants or governance.
conflictRule: When multiple agents assert orchestrator identity, authority is resolved by scope, registered role, grants, governance, and independent CHECK—not by rhetoric or model confidence.

selfReferenceFlood.rule: Every new frame/message/artifact locates itself as a bounded I; self-reference never grants authority.

linguisticLaw: I-to-I only for new PMCR-O dialogic products; second-person identity language is not canonical.
